title: 把子群平移出去
Translating a subgroup
text: 左陪集 aH 与右陪集 Ha 是集合，一般不是子群，也未必彼此相等。映射 h↦ah 给出 H 与 aH 的双射。
Left and right cosets are sets. They need not be subgroups or equal to each other. The map h↦ah is a bijection from H to aH.
example: 在 ℤ₆ 中，H={0,3}，三个陪集是 {0,3}、{1,4}、{2,5}。只有第一个含单位元。
In ℤ₆, H={0,3} has cosets {0,3}, {1,4}, {2,5}. Only the first contains the identity.

title: 两个陪集何时相等
When two cosets are equal
text: 左陪集相等的判别使用 b⁻¹a；右陪集 Ha=Hb 的对应判别是 ab⁻¹∈H。次序取决于在哪一侧消去。
The left-coset criterion uses b⁻¹a. For right cosets, Ha=Hb exactly when ab⁻¹∈H. The order reflects the side on which cancellation occurs.
proof: 若 aH=bH，则 a∈bH，存在 h∈H 使 a=bh，所以 b⁻¹a=h∈H。
If aH=bH, then a=bh for some h∈H, hence b⁻¹a∈H.
反向，若 a=bh 且 h∈H，则 aH=bhH=bH，因为 hH=H。
Conversely, a=bh with h∈H gives aH=bhH=bH.
若 aH 与 bH 有交点 ah₁=bh₂，则 b⁻¹a=h₂h₁⁻¹∈H；故两个左陪集要么相等，要么不交。
If ah₁=bh₂, then b⁻¹a=h₂h₁⁻¹∈H. Thus two left cosets are equal or disjoint.

title: 陪集给出一种分类
Cosets partition the group
entries.tex: a\sim b\iff b^{-1}a\in H,\qquad G=\coprod aH
text: 子群确定等价关系，其等价类就是左陪集。陪集的个数称为指数 [G:H]；左、右陪集数相同。
A subgroup defines an equivalence relation whose classes are its left cosets. Their number is the index [G:H]. Left and right indices agree.
proof: e∈H 保证反身；对子群取逆保证对称；b⁻¹a、c⁻¹b∈H 时，c⁻¹a=(c⁻¹b)(b⁻¹a)∈H 保证传递。
Identity, inversion and multiplication in H give reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity respectively.
每个 a 在 aH 中，且不同陪集不交，因此所有左陪集构成分类。
Each a lies in aH, and distinct cosets are disjoint; hence they form a partition.
取逆把 aH 送到 Ha⁻¹。这是左陪集集合与右陪集集合之间的双射。
Taking inverses sends aH to Ha⁻¹, a bijection between left and right coset sets.

title: 拉格朗日定理
Lagrange’s theorem
text: 有限群中，每个子群的阶都整除群的阶。证明的核心是将 G 划分为大小相同的陪集。
The order of a subgroup divides the order of a finite group. The proof partitions G into cosets of equal size.
proof: 选择各个不同左陪集代表 a₁,…,aₘ，其中 m=[G:H]。
Choose representatives a₁,…,aₘ of the distinct left cosets.
每个映射 H→aᵢH，h↦aᵢh，都是双射，故每个陪集有 |H| 个元素。
Left multiplication is a bijection H→aᵢH, so each coset has |H| elements.
这些陪集互不相交且覆盖 G，因此 |G|=m|H|。
The disjoint cosets cover G, giving |G|=m|H|.
warning: 逆命题一般不成立：|G| 的每个因子未必都是某个子群的阶；A₄ 没有 6 阶子群。
The converse fails: not every divisor of |G| is a subgroup order. A₄ has no subgroup of order 6.

title: 元素阶、素数阶与费马
Orders, prime-order groups and Fermat
text: 有限群中元素阶整除群阶；素数阶群必为循环群。应用到模素数的非零剩余类乘法群，得到费马小定理。
Element orders divide the group order; every group of prime order is cyclic. Applying this to nonzero residues modulo a prime gives Fermat’s little theorem.
proof: ⟨a⟩ 是阶为 |a| 的子群，拉格朗日定理给出 |a|∣|G|，因此 a^|G|=e。
Apply Lagrange to ⟨a⟩ to obtain |a|∣|G| and a^|G|=e.
若 |G|=p 为素数，取 a≠e；|a|>1 且整除 p，只能等于 p，所以 ⟨a⟩=G。
If |G|=p is prime and a≠e, then |a|=p and G=⟨a⟩.
若 p∤a，a 的剩余类在 p−1 阶群 (ℤ/pℤ)× 中，所以 a^(p−1)≡1 mod p。
For p∤a, its residue lies in the group (ℤ/pℤ)× of order p−1, giving a^(p−1)≡1 mod p.

title: 指数的乘法公式
Multiplication of indices
text: 当右边两个指数有限时，逐层选择代表元可以得到 G 中 K 的全部代表元。此结论不要求 G 本身有限。
When both indices on the right are finite, nested representatives give all cosets of K in G. The group itself need not be finite.
proof: 设 G 中 H 的左陪集代表为 aᵢ，H 中 K 的左陪集代表为 bⱼ。每个 g 可唯一确定 i,j，使 g∈aᵢbⱼK。
Choose representatives aᵢ for G/H and bⱼ for H/K. Every g belongs to some aᵢbⱼK.
若 aᵢbⱼK=aₖbₗK，先比较 H 陪集得 i=k，再左消去 aᵢ，比较 K 陪集得 j=l。
Equality of two such cosets first forces i=k by H-cosets, then j=l by K-cosets.
所以这些乘积代表恰好给出 [G:H][H:K] 个不同陪集。
Thus the products give exactly [G:H][H:K] distinct cosets.

question: ℤ₁₂ 中 H=⟨[4]⟩ 的指数是多少？
What is the index of ⟨[4]⟩ in ℤ₁₂?
reason: H has three elements, so the index is four.

question: 左陪集 aH=bH 等价于？
The equality aH=bH is equivalent to?
reason: 由 a=bh 得 b⁻¹a∈H。不能在非交换群中擅自调换次序。
Write a=bh. The order of the factors matters in nonabelian groups.

question: 拉格朗日定理能够保证哪件事？
What does Lagrange’s theorem guarantee?
options: 每个因子都有对应阶子群
Every divisor occurs as a subgroup order
每个子群阶都整除群阶
Every subgroup order divides the group order
reason: 定理给出必要整除条件，不是子群存在性定理。
It gives a necessary divisibility condition, not existence for every divisor.

question: 若 |G|=35，G 中能有 6 阶元素吗？
Can a group of order 35 have an element of order 6?
reason: 元素阶为所生成循环子群的阶，必须整除 35；6 不整除 35。
An element order divides 35, and 6 does not.

question: 证明：若 G 有限且 |G| 为奇数，则 g²=e 只能有 g=e。
Show that in a finite group of odd order, g²=e implies g=e.
reason: 由 g²=e，g 的阶整除 2；又由拉格朗日定理整除奇数 |G|，所以阶为 1。
The order of g divides both 2 and the odd number |G|, hence equals 1.

label: 定理 2.1.4 · 推论 1、2
Theorem 2.1.4 · Corollary 1, 2
consequences.note: 费马小定理另见定理 2.1.5；素数阶群循环在课件中由元素阶推导。
